name: AI Feedback Summary Workflow
description: Starter n8n workflow for summarizing user feedback with an AI node, adding a human review step, and logging the result.

nodes.name: AI Summary Draft
nodes.notes: Replace this no-op with your preferred AI node. Prompt: summarize feedback, classify urgency, mark privacy data, and output fixed JSON fields.

nodes.name: Human Review Required
nodes.notes: Send the AI summary to Slack/Email/Notion for human review before contacting users or publishing anything.

nodes.name: Log Result
nodes.notes: Write input source, AI output, review status, execution time, and errors to your logging destination.

meta.safetyNote: This starter template intentionally uses no-op placeholders for AI, notification, and logging nodes. Configure credentials and keep human review before external sending.
